parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale fixes all three error targets: (1) it removes the incorrect claim that the comment provides concrete implementation details, correctly noting the absence of specific guidance on content, formulation, or placement; (2) it corrects the unsupported inference that authors know how to apply the action, acknowledging they only know what to do; and (3) it replaces the incorrect score-5 mapping with a description of the rubric level matching explicit-action-but-vague-execution. The rationale preserves the original observation that an explicit action is stated, does not invent evidence, and avoids directly stating a numeric score or gold label. It reads coherently and can be inserted as rescorer reasoning.
